wikipedia#8.title: 1955: At a meeting of its general assembly, the European Broadcasting Union approved the staging of the first Eurovision Song Contest.

wikipedia#9.title: 1944: The Guatemalan Revolution began with a small group of army officers led by Francisco Javier Arana and Jacobo Árbenz launching a coup against dictator Jorge Ubico.

wikipedia#10.title: 1943: World War II: Allied aircraft sank the German cargo ship Sinfra, killing mostly Italian POWs.

wikipedia#11.title: 1914: First World War: Allied forces began engaging German troops at the First Battle of Ypres.

wikipedia#12.title: 1864: American Civil War: Despite incurring nearly twice as many casualties as the Confederates, the Union army emerged victorious at the Battle of Cedar Creek.
